name: NIST SP 800-53
description: Security and Privacy Controls for Federal Information Systems and Organizations.

controls.title: Remote Access Management & Encryption
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, disallow cleartext remote access mechanisms; disable Telnet and restrict management connectivity strictly to FIPS-approved SSH.

controls.title: Authenticator Management & Password Complexity
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, satisfy NIST authenticator controls by configuring a minimum password length of at least 12 characters across all administrative roles.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication for Central Administration
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, enforce enterprise-wide identity verification: integrate device access with centralized AAA directory services (RADIUS/TACACS+).

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity (HTTPS)
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, ensure web administrative traffic is protected in transit with HTTPS and approved TLS ciphers.

controls.title: Least Functionality - Restrict Insecure HTTP Server
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, eliminate attack surface by disabling unencrypted HTTP daemon services: configure 'no ip http server'.

controls.title: Event Logging and Audit Record Transmission
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, configure audit log generation and automated forwarding to designated organization-defined logging repositories.

controls.title: Time Stamp Synchronization via NTP
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, synchronize internal system clocks with authoritative external time sources using authenticated NTP protocol.

controls.title: Session Termination After Inactivity Period
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, mandate automatic session lock/termination by configuring idle timeout to 15 minutes or less.

controls.title: System Use Notification and Advisory Banner
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, display approved federal system use notification warning prior to granting administrative access.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection of Stored Credentials
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, store administrative secrets using strong cryptographic hashes (Type 9 Scrypt or PBKDF2), never cleartext or weak Type 7.

controls.title: Boundary Protection and Ingress Filtering
controls.remediation: For {vendor}, deploy packet-filtering access control lists to separate management network interfaces from untrusted zones.
